title: 第859章 这种小伎俩第858章 后招
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 起先是一两只妖说话，后面声音越来越大，元逍等人回头，看着一个个劝他们不要管他们，尽快离开栖灵宝境的妖，心里也蛮不是滋味的。
他们活命的机会是攸叶姑娘用天劫换来的，他们完全可以离开的毫无心理负担，但听着这一句句临死前的遗言，看着那一张张鲜活的面容，他们发现，他们做不到无动于衷。
生灵和死物的区别就在这里，只要有思想就无法完全摒弃情感。
一股强烈的厌恶从心底深处生出，元逍等人冷冷看着高空闭上的巨眸，默默在心里道，他们会记住这三个月的艰险，记住今日迫不得已的屈辱，日后千百倍报复在魔族身上。
地面裂缝交织在一起如同蛛网，再多碰一下便会彻底碎裂，空间呜呜刮着带有魔气的邪风，目不能视，耳不能听，如果有地狱，该就是这般景象。
且羡安看向林筱，想看看林筱的表情，以他对林筱的了解，林筱大概率不会向魔族老祖低头，可不低头难道真要死在栖灵宝境？
林筱注意到且羡安的视线，不紧不慢的勾了自己垂落肩膀的一缕发丝打转，“别着急，我有感觉，天劫快酝酿完全了，大乘级别的合体劫，我也是第一次见，有点小兴奋呢。”
天劫仿佛听到了林筱话，配合的响了一下。
小兴奋？且羡安都要佩服林筱的松弛了，他感觉林筱和他们不在一个世界，他们这边急得要死，林筱自己反而期待起来了。
且羡安不知，有一个人比他还急还崩溃。
烛冥昪玦虽闭着眼，但他的神识一直紧紧关注着林筱，不放过林筱任何一个表情变化，只要林筱稍稍有那么一点松动，他就赢了。
可他整出这么大动静，那青衣女狐非但不着急，反而兴奋起来。
他真的很想钻进那青衣女狐体内，看看她胸膛里跳动的是心脏还是一块钢铁。
她难道，真不怕死吗？
不管她是真不怕死，还是识破了他的阴谋，他都等不下去了。
外界劫云已经开始扩展，等劫云停下来，他数万年的心血真要付诸东流了。
他活了不知多少年，当年魔主都只是打败他没让他低头，今天，他认输了。
咬牙切齿蹦出三个字。
烛冥昪玦想杀一个人的心从未如此强烈过，他必须用尽全身力气才能不让自己去捏死那个往日里他吹口气便能灭杀数百次，现在却逼得他不得不一再后退的蝼蚁。
听到烛冥昪玦声音，群妖先是一愣，不明白他这么生气为何，不是要吞噬他们吗，怎么吞一半又自己跳出来了？
随即恍然大悟，群妖深吸一口气，又一次被魔族的狡诈刷新认知。
他是故意的！
他劝不动青衣女狐，便故意说那些话来让他们误会他有后招，让他们去劝青衣女狐离开。
若青衣女狐真的离开，那才中了这魔族老祖的圈套。
阴险！不要脸！
群妖把他们脑海里所有的脏话都骂了一遍，问候了烛冥昪玦祖宗十八代数次。
亏他们那么伤感，以为真的没救了，结果是被魔族阴了。
骂完后便是庆幸，幸好青衣女狐她们没有上当。
不敢想，若是青衣女狐她们走了后才发现一切是魔族老祖的圈套该会有多么震怒？
content_en:
At first, one or two demons spoke, and then the voices became louder and louder. Yuan Xiao and others turned around and looked at the demons who were urging them to leave them alone and leave the Lingbao Realm as soon as possible. They felt quite uncomfortable.
Their chance of survival was bought by Miss Youye through a catastrophe. They could leave without any psychological burden. However, listening to these last words before death and looking at the vivid faces, they found that they could not remain indifferent.
This is the difference between living things and dead things. As long as you have thoughts, you cannot completely abandon emotions.
A strong disgust arose from the depths of their hearts. Yuan Xiao and the others looked coldly at the closed giant eyes in the sky, and said silently in their hearts that they would remember the hardships and dangers of these three months, remember the forced humiliation today, and take revenge on the demons a thousandfold in the future.
The cracks on the ground are intertwined like a spider web, and if touched again, they will completely shatter. The space is whining with evil winds carrying evil spirits. The eyes cannot see and the ears cannot hear. If there is a hell, this is what it will be like.
Qi Xian'an looked at Lin Xiao, wanting to see Lin Xiao's expression. Based on his understanding of Lin Xiao, there was a high probability that Lin Xiao would not bow to the ancestor of the demon clan. But if he didn't bow his head, would he really die in the Qiling Treasure Realm?
Lin Xiao noticed Qie Xian'an's gaze, and slowly twirled a strand of hair hanging down her shoulders, "Don't worry, I have a feeling that the heavenly catastrophe is almost ready. This is the first time I've seen a Mahayana-level combined catastrophe, so I'm a little excited."
Tianjie seemed to have heard Lin Xiao's words and rang in response.
A little excited? Qi Xian'an almost admired Lin Xiao's relaxation. He felt that Lin Xiao was not in the same world as them. They were anxious to death, but Lin Xiao himself was looking forward to it.
Little did Jixian'an know that there was someone who was even more anxious and collapsed than him.
Although Zhu Ming Mingjue had his eyes closed, his consciousness had been paying close attention to Lin Xiao, not letting go of any change in Lin Xiao's expression. As long as Lin Xiao relaxed even a little bit, he would win.
But when he made such a big noise, the female fox in green was not anxious, but became excited.
He really wanted to get into the green-clothed female fox's body and see if what was beating in her chest was a heart or a piece of steel.
她难道，真不怕死吗？
Regardless of whether she was really not afraid of death or had discovered his conspiracy, he couldn't wait any longer.
The calamity cloud in the outside world has begun to expand. When the calamity cloud stops, his tens of thousands of years of hard work will really be in vain.
He has lived for who knows how many years. Back then, the demon lord only defeated him without letting him bow. Today, he gave up.
"Forget it, you are cruel!"
咬牙切齿蹦出三个字。
Zhu Ming Minjue's desire to kill someone had never been so strong. He had to use all his strength not to crush the ant that he could kill hundreds of times with just a breath in the past, but now he was forced to retreat repeatedly.
Hearing Zhu Ming Minjue's voice, the demons were stunned for a moment. They didn't understand why he was so angry. Didn't he want to devour them? Why did he jump out after swallowing half of them?
Immediately, they suddenly realized that the group of demons took a deep breath, and their understanding was once again refreshed by the cunning of the demons.
He did it on purpose!
He couldn't persuade the female fox in Tsing Yi, so he deliberately said those words to make them misunderstand that he had a plan, so that they could persuade the female fox in Tsing Yi to leave.
If the green-clad female fox really left, she would have fallen into the trap of the demon ancestor.
insidious! shameless!
The demons cursed all the curse words in their minds and greeted the eighteenth generation of Zhu Ming Minjue's ancestors several times.
Thanks to them being so sad, they thought there was really no hope, but in the end they were tricked by the demons.
After scolding them, they felt lucky. Fortunately, the female fox in green and the others were not fooled.
I can't imagine how angry the Tsing Yi Fox Lady and the others would be if they found out after they left that everything was a trap by the Demon Clan Ancestor?
